data.title: 花火 · 朱漆屏风后的愚者密戏
data.description: 匹诺康尼隐秘雅间的绘金朱漆屏风前挂着几盏微晃的红纸灯笼，花火赤足斜倚在铺着绯红锦缎的矮榻上，指尖漫不经心地勾着腰侧金铃细绳轻晃出清脆声响。绯红漆金镂空抹胸睡裙在暖红灯影里显得妖冶又危险，她眯起红眸坏笑着邀你猜猜下一幕是谁的回合。
data.location: 绘金屏风与红纸灯笼掩映的幽暗和风雅间
data.action: 斜倚锦缎矮榻轻晃腰间金铃细绳，眯眼狡黠坏笑
data.lighting: 绯红灯笼暖光与屏风金箔反光交错，营造戏剧舞台感
data.camera: 微俯四分之三中景，狐面、金铃与高开衩薄纱构图张力十足
data.mood: 戏谑、魅惑、危险而令人目眩的欢愉气息
data.promptProse: Reclining barefoot on a crimson silk daybed in front of a gilded folding screen and glowing red lanterns, Sparkle toys lazily with the gold side-lacing cords of her scarlet cutout tube dress. Miniature gold bells glint in the warm theatrical light as she narrows her eyes in an unmistakable, teasing grin.
data.animaCaption: Reclining before a gilded screen and red lanterns, she toys with her gold side cords and grins mischievously.
data.nsfwProse: Laced gold cords trace the geometric side cutouts of her scarlet-and-gold tube dress above the asymmetrical high-slit sheer hem.
